documents.title: Faculty Guidance - Academic Integrity (Academic integrity and AI)
documents.summary: The Provost's faculty-guidance page includes a short AI section recording a Faculty Council recommendation that syllabi carry one of two sample statements, one banning AI-written work and one allowing AI with citation and an appended transcript. The rest of the page covers general academic-integrity procedure.
documents.stance_why: The page "recommended that all syllabi include one of two statements" (not allowed, or allowed with attribution) and sets no single rule itself; the choice is the instructor's, so delegates with two template tiers.

units.why: The Faculty Council recommendation that "all syllabi include one of two statements" requires instructors to state an AI position in every syllabus, so it is a syllabus-statement rule (P09) addressed to instructors before the course.

units.policy: The Faculty Council recommends that all syllabi include one of two statements concerning the use or restriction of AI tools in the course.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Guidance
documents.summary: The Center for Learning Design page gives guidance for instructors: sample syllabus language, ways instructors and students can use the licensed Microsoft Copilot Chat, authentic assessment ideas, data protection cautions and an FAQ on detectors and entering student work.
documents.stance_why: The page states "Faculty determine their own policy for generative AI use in their course" and offers sample syllabus text, so it sets no stance itself and delegates.
